note: For each shot write need (what must literally be on screen for this sentence), 2-4 English queries (concrete first, then broader), kind (video|image), look (modern = today's colour HD footage, archive = old film and historical pictures, any), min (shortest side in px, optional) and avoid. Then: footage find <NN>.
